open_points.subject: A3 repeated placement and INV-06
open_points.text: INV-06: at most one placement exists per project and source content, and a repeated placement writes nothing.
open_points.question: Must INV-06, P-06, R0-15 and M04 permit creation of an absent project lock file and its folders during a repeated placement, or must a replay leave all durable state unchanged?
options: The A3 rule 2 exception wins: a replay may create the lock file and its folders but changes nothing else.
The no-write promises win: an existing placement must be returned without taking or creating the project lock.
Change the invariant and earlier descriptions so they explicitly distinguish placement state from lock-management state.
open_points.default_guess: Apply the A3 rule 2 exception and amend INV-06 and the earlier no-write descriptions to say that only an absent lock file and its required folders may be created.

witness.initial: A placement record and stored image exist, but a host crash has left the project lock file or its unsynchronised parent folder absent; the source file is also absent.
events: The caller requests delivery with the existing source_id.
The service finds the existing placement after reaching the project-lock step.
outcomes: A3 rule 2 creates the missing lock path and returns replayed with the stored placement.
INV-06, P-06, R0-15 and M04 require the repeated placement to write or create nothing.
witness.observer: The owner or a filesystem check sees whether the lock file and folders were created.

open_points.subject: M07 PublicationMark.marked_at
open_points.question: What instant does a fresh publication mark record, where does that instant come from, what datetime representation and precision are stored, and how many readings does one mark operation take?
options: Read an injected clock once when the new mark is created and store that instant as UTC.
Use the time at which the Portal publication completed.
Use the request-arrival time or the host wall clock directly.
Store a naive UTC datetime or a timezone-aware UTC datetime.
open_points.default_guess: Read an injected UTC clock exactly once after validation and while holding the project lock, only for a newly created mark; store a timezone-aware UTC datetime and take no clock reading for replayed or refused marks.

witness.initial: A placement exists and has no publication mark.
events: The calling flow later reports the Portal photo_id to the deliverer.
outcomes: One implementation stores the deliverer's current UTC clock value when M07 is created.
Another stores a request-arrival, Portal-publication, local-wall-clock or naive-UTC value.
witness.observer: A caller or later scan reading the persisted mark sees a different marked_at value or representation.

open_points.subject: A2 camera time zone
open_points.question: Which settings-model field supplies this zone, what representation it uses, and whether it is an IANA civil-time zone or a fixed offset must be stated.
options: A named settings field containing an IANA time-zone identifier interpreted with civil-time transition rules.
A named settings field containing a fixed UTC offset.
The host process or operating-system local time zone.
open_points.default_guess: Use a required named settings-model field containing an IANA time-zone identifier and resolve it with the pinned time-zone database.

witness.initial: A source has a usable offset-free EXIF DateTimeOriginal during a period when Europe/Madrid differs from UTC, and its modification time does not make the camera value unusable.
events: The service interprets the offset-free camera value.
outcomes: An implementation using Europe/Madrid converts the value with Madrid's applicable offset.
An implementation using UTC or the host's local zone produces a different UTC photo_date.
witness.observer: The Portal and the placement record expose the different photo_date.

open_points.subject: A6 INV-12 Required tests
open_points.text: marks of two `photo_id` values, in one process and in separate processes, answer one `marked`, `replayed` for the same value and `publication_conflict` for the other
open_points.question: What exact calls and ordering must each INV-12 witness perform so that both replay of the winning photo_id and conflict for the other photo_id are required?
options: Race two different photo_id calls, then repeat whichever value won and require replayed.
Run three concurrent calls using two photo_id values and prescribe which value is duplicated and which outcomes are allowed.
Create the mark first, then concurrently call once with the same photo_id and once with a different photo_id.
open_points.default_guess: Race two distinct photo_id calls, require one marked and one publication_conflict, then call again with the winning photo_id and require replayed; perform this history once with in-process concurrency and once across processes.

witness.initial: One placement exists and has no publication mark.
events: Two callers concurrently mark it with different photo_id values.
After the race, a caller sends the winning photo_id again.
outcomes: A test interpreting the passage as only the two concurrent calls checks marked and publication_conflict but has no same-value replay.
A test interpreting it as a three-call history also checks replayed and preservation of the winner's marked_at.
witness.observer: The generated test suite and an implementation that mishandles replay after a race distinguish the interpretations.

open_points.subject: A2 camera time zone
open_points.rule: Таблица выше — исчерпывающий список путей значения, и у каждого из них своя форма: перечисление называется адресом, константа поставщика — `the imported X constant`, настройка — полем объекта настроек.
open_points.question: Replace this phrase with the explicit field of the settings object, including the field's model type, that supplies the time zone.

open_points.subject: A3 rule 2
open_points.rule: **Член перечисления** note называет его именем рядом с адресом перечисления: `the EXPENSE_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction`.
open_points.question: Name the REPLAYED member of = models.PlacementStatus instead of naming the member only by its value.

open_points.subject: A6 INV-12 Required tests
open_points.text: concurrent placements of one source, in one process and in separate processes, answer one `placed` and otherwise `replayed` and leave one placement record and one stored image (`test_separate_processes_leave_one_placement`), and marks of two `photo_id` values, in one process and in separate processes, answer one `marked`, `replayed` for the same value and `publication_conflict` for the other, and leave one mark record holding the `photo_id` whose call answered `marked` (`test_concurrent_calls_leave_one_placement_and_one_mark`, `test_separate_processes_leave_one_mark`).
open_points.rule: **Член перечисления** note называет его именем рядом с адресом перечисления: `the EXPENSE_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction`.
open_points.question: Replace every value-only enumeration reference with the member name and its model address: PLACED and REPLAYED of = models.PlacementStatus, MARKED and REPLAYED of = models.MarkStatus, and PUBLICATION_CONFLICT of = models.RefusalCode.
